action.action-desc: Ms. Mace submitted the following resolution; which was referred to the Committee on Ethics

form.official-title: Amending the Rules of the House of Representatives to prohibit a Member, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner from cohabitating with any employee of the House of Representatives.

section.header: Prohibition with respect to Member, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner cohabitation with House employees
section.text: Rule XXIII of the Rules of the House of Representatives is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating clause 22 as clause 23; and
by inserting after clause 21 the following:

rules-clause.text: A Member, Delegate, or Resident Commissioner may not cohabitate with any employee of the House. This paragraph does not apply with respect to any relationship between two people who are married to each other.
